# Resource (rootly_status_page_announcement)





<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `body` (String) Body of the announcement
- `status_page_id` (String) ID of the status page the announcement was posted to
- `title` (String) Title of the announcement

### Optional

- `notify_subscribers` (Boolean) Controls if status page subscribers should be notified. Defaults to true. Value must be one of true or false

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `published_at` (String) Date the announcement was published
- `user_id` (Number) ID of the user who posted the announcement

## Import

rootly_status_page_announcement can be imported using the [`import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import).

```sh
terraform import rootly_status_page_announcement.primary a816421c-6ceb-481a-87c4-585e47451f24
```

Or using an [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import).
